patch_description: Introduce geometry-aware coordinated proposals for a fraction of annealing iterations. Rather than relying solely on isotropic Gaussian perturbations, these moves select one of the currently smallest triangles and displace a chosen vertex along the signed normal direction that directly increases that triangle’s area. A second vertex receives a smaller tangential displacement. This preserves useful freedom to repair neighboring active constraints while allowing the search to cross bottlenecks that one-vertex moves frequently cannot escape. The proposal remains deterministic through the existing seeded generator and retains the original stochastic proposal mechanism for broad exploration.
